description: Real LPA-approved scheme, Pond Bridge, Johnston, Pembrokeshire (04/0070/PA reserved matters, 2005; varied 24/0052/PA, 2024). 123 dwellings in a multi-loop estate (Green Lane / Bracken Way loops plus Moors Road frontage) accessed from a single roundabout off the A40 to the west. Deliberately included as a stress test: v0 only builds one dead-end ribbon road, so this scheme's loops/courtyards are structurally outside what it can produce — a large shortfall here is the EXPECTED, correct result, not a bug to chase or a reason to loosen the engine's topology.
expectedUnitsMethod: LPA-approved unit count, not derived from density or from this boundary trace. Confirmed directly from the 24/0052/PA application form's own description field: 'Submission of Approval of Reserved Matters Application for the construction of 123 residential dwellings - land at O.S. 5400, to the rear of filling station, Pond Bridge, Johnston, Haverfordwest, Pembrokeshire' (referencing the original 04/0070/PA reserved-matters decision, 30/09/2005). See test-sites/README.md for the boundary tracing method and error margin — that part IS approximate.
